scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:all: npm run install:all && npm run dev
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client"
